title: Week 1: Foundation
description: Install Claude Code, create your first CLAUDE.md, and understand autonomous vs. advisory AI
content:
Week 1: Foundation

Welcome to the WordPress + Claude Code training! This week, you'll get Claude Code installed, create your first CLAUDE.md context file, and complete hands-on exercises to understand how autonomous AI assistance works.

 Learning Objectives

By the end of Week 1, you will:

- ✅ Install and authenticate Claude Code CLI
- ✅ Create a CLAUDE.md context file for a WordPress project
- ✅ Understand the difference between autonomous and advisory AI
- ✅ Complete a simple plugin modif

title: Skills Library
description: Learn about custom Claude Code skills for WordPress development
content:
Skills Library

Custom skills extend Claude Code with specialized commands for WordPress development. Think of them as power-ups for specific tasks.

 What Are Skills?

Skills are pre-packaged prompts and workflows that execute complex tasks with a single command. Instead of typing long, detailed prompts, you can use a skill like /wp-perf-review to trigger a comprehensive performance audit.

 Benefits
- ⚡ Faster workflow: One command instead of multiple prompts
- 🎯 Consistency: Same audit pro
